notes: Bit rates stated as 125Mbps / 155Mbps; overview also cites 100Mbps Ethernet. Tx output power min/max and rx min/overload are average power (footnote 1). Rx minimum input power -36dBm valid per footnote 2 at 125Mbps PRBS7 and BER 1x10-12. Nominal wavelengths 1491nm/1511nm/1611nm/1625nm map to orderable variants C49/C51/C61/C62-E and transmit wavelength ranges in footnotes 3–6. Power budget 0–34dB (footnote 7). DDM reports Rx power reliably down to -25dBm; below -25dBm reporting unreliable and Rx_LOS asserted; Rx sensitivity still valid down to -36dBm when Rx_LOS asserted. OTDR: dynamic range typ 65dB, dead zone max 30m, resolution max 10m, accuracy max 50m. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power consumption < 0.9W.
